LearningModules.title: Junior Data modelling and storage - Module 1: Guided implementation
LearningModules.learningOutcome:
In Data modelling and storage, demonstrate the following junior tasks:
MS-DE01: Create an entity model from supplied requirements; verify keys and relationships against sample records.
MS-DE03: Build and load a small warehouse using a supplied schema and reconcile source-to-target counts.
MS-DE06: Fill a supplied data dictionary with field meanings, owners and structural metadata.
Submit evidence:
MS-DE01: Model diagram, schema, constraint checks and design rationale.
MS-DE03: Warehouse schema, load scripts, history tests and reconciliation results.
MS-DE06: Data dictionary, ownership records, change history and review findings.

LearningModules.title: Junior Data modelling and storage - Module 2: Guided validation
LearningModules.learningOutcome:
In Data modelling and storage, demonstrate the following junior tasks:
MS-DE13: Measure a supplied warehouse query before and after one guided optimisation; confirm unchanged results.
MS-DE16: Identify downstream consumers of a supplied dataset change using existing lineage information.
Submit evidence:
MS-DE13: Workload definition, before/after measurements, result reconciliation and decision record.
MS-DE16: Dependency map, affected-consumer list, assumptions and change verification results.

LearningModules.title: Junior Data pipeline implementation and integration - Module 1: Guided implementation
LearningModules.learningOutcome:
In Data pipeline implementation and integration, demonstrate the following junior tasks:
MS-DE02: Implement a supplied transformation specification and verify expected outputs with guidance.
MS-DE04: Document source fields, target fields and supplied transformations in a mapping template.
MS-DE08: Describe a source-to-destination flow from a supplied integration design.
Submit evidence:
MS-DE02: Runnable application, input/output fixtures, test results and execution logs.
MS-DE04: Mapping document, sample transformations, exception decisions and validation results.
MS-DE08: Flow diagram, contracts, failure scenarios and design decisions.

LearningModules.title: Junior Data pipeline implementation and integration - Module 2: Guided validation
LearningModules.learningOutcome:

Submit evidence:

MS-DE11: Rule specification, transformation code, edge-case fixtures and test results.
MS-DE12: Dependency graph, orchestration configuration and repeated-run/failure test results.

rubricDefinitions.score0: No usable result, or result contradicts the task.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Major errors prevent the main task from succeeding.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Main path works; material edge cases or constraints remain unresolved.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Agreed main, boundary and failure checks pass; only minor non-blocking issues remain.
rubricDefinitions.score4: All agreed checks pass and additional justified checks support robust correctness.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Artifact and expected/actual checks tied to the assigned skill task.

rubricDefinitions.score1: Claims rely on unrepeatable or incomplete demonstrations.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Main-path evidence is repeatable; important failure cases or provenance are missing.
rubricDefinitions.score3: Evidence is reproducible and covers agreed boundary/failure cases with traceable inputs.
rubricDefinitions.score4: Evidence is reproducible, risk-based and includes independent cross-checks plus explicit limitations.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Inputs, method, outputs, logs and relevant failure/boundary cases.

rubricDefinitions.score0: Cannot perform the task even with the permitted support.
rubricDefinitions.score1: Needs substantial support beyond the level allowance.
rubricDefinitions.score2: Completes most work within the allowance, but needs extra corrective intervention.

rubricDefinitions.score4: Meets level allowance throughout; anticipates and resolves relevant issues without extra corrective help.
rubricDefinitions.evidenceRule: Record assessor interventions and distinguish permitted guidance from corrective help.
